about.title: Garden Grove Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Nine people died in traffic collisions in Garden Grove in 2025, according to public records. Behind each number is a household in Orange County that has to keep going while also deciding whether to ask legal questions at all. A California wrongful death claim is a civil action, kept separate from any criminal case tied to the same event, and it is brought by specific relatives: a spouse or registered domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents or heirs when no one in that first group exists. Whether the loss happened on Garden Grove Boulevard, along SR-22, or at a crossing on Chapman Avenue or Brookhurst Street, the same rules apply. The clock runs two years from the date of death, and it moves faster when a city, county, or state agency may share responsibility. We handle these cases on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Garden Grove Families Choose Us

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. We can tell you quickly whether you qualify and how a shared claim works.

items.title: The deadline is tracked from day one
items.desc: Two years from the date of death is the general rule, but a claim that may involve a public agency has to move much sooner. Getting started early keeps that timeline from becoming a problem.

items.title: Every category of loss is considered
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance are all recognized in California. We work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member was killed on Garden Grove Boulevard. Does it matter that the city maintains the road?
items.answer: It can. If a public entity such as the City of Garden Grove, Orange County, or Caltrans may have contributed to the conditions, a formal claim usually has to be filed with that agency in a matter of months, well ahead of the standard two-year deadline. We can evaluate whether a government claim is even relevant and, if so, handle the shorter timeline.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, regardless of whether prosecutors file charges or how a criminal case ends. Many families pursue both at once, and evidence gathered in one can sometimes be useful in the other.

items.question: What does it cost to get a case review?
items.answer: Nothing. We provide free case reviews, and we handle wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning we are paid only if there is a recovery.
